label: .copyEmptyCommand: Copy stays enabled with no command to copy
find: public var copyCommandUnavailable: String? { command.isEmpty ? Self.nothingToCopy : nil }

label: .configCopyReadsCommand: the config's Copy follows the command, not the config
find: public var copyConfigUnavailable: String? { configJSON.isEmpty ? Self.nothingToCopy : nil }
replace: public var copyConfigUnavailable: String? { command.isEmpty ? Self.nothingToCopy : nil }

label: .bundleOutsideApp: a path outside AfterGlow.app names a bundle
find: guard let index = parts.firstIndex(of: "AfterGlow.app") else { return nil }
replace: guard let index = parts.firstIndex(where: { $0.hasSuffix(".app") }) else { return nil }
